summary: Southern Company filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for 35,000,000 2026 Series A Equity Units at a $50 stated amount, each initially a Corporate Unit of a purchase contract plus 1/40 interests in $1,000 principal Series 2026C RSNs due 2031 and Series 2026D RSNs due 2034. The purchase contract obligates cash purchase of SO shares on December 15, 2029, referencing a $93.84 close on November 11, 2026. Underwriters hold a 5,000,000-unit over-allotment option; BofA Securities and Barclays are joint book-runners; NYSE listing under SONN is expected. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation.
